uncertainties.note: Post-mission Nadesico epilogue exchange (Akito rescuing Yurika). Speaker mapping between Ruri Hoshino and other bridge crew is not tagged in the corpus; lines are translated without asserting which named character speaks each one, beyond the two people directly addressed by name (Akito, Yurika).

First-person monologue (a former high-schooler who dislikes the military but fights for the people here) strongly matches Barrel Orland's established voice/backstory, and dialogue_07151 addresses 'Barrel' directly in reply, but the monologue rows themselves do not name the speaker, so no name was inserted into the visible text.
Reply to Barrel is not explicitly attributed; likely Faye Rochenante given the preceding Faye/Barrel exchange (7141-7144), but not asserted in the visible text.

Berkt is treated as the already-established original character name from AGENTS.md/prior scenes; no separate glossary.json or character_names_021.json entry was found during this slice's research, so this is flagged for orchestrator confirmation rather than a fresh proposal.
